sessions.level: When life gets overwhelming, and you need to de-stress and unwind, our signature journey is here for you. Think of this experience as a massage for the mind. Navigate through our serene spaces designed for optimal relaxation and restoration, including our immersive theatre room, light & sound therapy dome, breathwork and meditation lounge and thermae. Please know our thermae is a silent space. Guests receive refreshments, a towel and a locker for maximum comfort each visit.

Unwind and relax with EQ’s Bathing Experience, designed to restore both mind and body. Over 90 minutes, immerse yourself in century old bathing traditions utilising our purposefully designed hot mineral spa (35-37 degrees), traditional Finnish sauna (90 degrees), aromatherapy steam room (55 degrees), and invigorating cold plunges (5-7 degrees). Embark on your own journey through the space or try one of our seasonal protocol circuits.

Please know our thermae is a silent space. Guests receive refreshments, a towel and a locker for maximum comfort each visit.

Unwind and relax with EQ’s Bathing Experience, designed to restore both mind and body. Embark on your own journey through the space or try one of our seasonal protocol circuits.

Please know our thermae is a silent space. Guests receive refreshments, a towel and a locker for maximum comfort each visit.

Unwind and relax with EQ’s Bathing Experience, designed to restore both mind and body. Over 90 minutes, immerse yourself in century old bathing traditions utilising our purposefully designed hot mineral spa (35-37 degrees), traditional Finnish sauna (90 degrees), aromatherapy steam room (55 degrees), and invigorating cold plunges (5-7 degrees). Embark on your own journey through the space or try one of our seasonal protocol circuits.

Please know our thermae is a silent space. Guests receive refreshments, a towel and a locker for maximum comfort each visit.

Unwind and relax with EQ’s Bathing Experience, designed to restore both mind and body. Over 90 minutes, immerse yourself in century old bathing traditions utilising our purposefully designed hot mineral spa (35-37 degrees), traditional Finnish sauna (90 degrees), aromatherapy steam room (55 degrees), and invigorating cold plunges (5-7 degrees). Embark on your own journey through the space or try one of our seasonal protocol circuits.

Embark on your own journey through the space or try one of our seasonal protocol circuits.

Exclusive to women and guided by an all-female team, our Signature Journey offers a serene escape when life feels a bit overwhelming. Imagine it as a massage for the mind, where you’ll unwind in spaces designed for ultimate relaxation and rejuvenation. Explore our immersive theatre room, light & sound therapy dome, breathwork and meditation lounge, and thermae, all crafted to help you de-stress and restore balance. Please know our thermae is a silent space. Guests receive refreshments, a towel and a locker for maximum comfort each visit.

Please know our thermae is a silent space. Guests receive refreshments, a towel and a locker for maximum comfort each visit.

Slow Restorative Yoga

No prior yoga experience needed—just come as you are and allow yourself to fully relax.

Yin Yoga & Sound

Experience deep relaxation and inner balance with our Yin Yoga & Sound class. This gentle, meditative practice combines long-held, restorative yoga poses with the therapeutic vibrations of sound to calm the nervous system and release tension. The combination of deep stretching and resonant sound helps to improve flexibility, enhance mindfulness, and bring a profound sense of peace.

Perfect for all levels, this class is ideal for anyone looking to unwind, reset, and reconnect with themselves.

Perfect for all levels, this class is ideal for anyone looking to unwind, reset, and reconnect with themselves.

Express Bathing Experience

Reset your body and mind in just 45 minutes with EQ’s 45-minute Bathhouse Session—a dynamic contrast therapy designed for those short on time but seeking maximum impact. Express Bathing Experience

Reset your body and mind in just 45 minutes with EQ’s 45-minute Bathhouse Session—a dynamic contrast therapy designed for those short on time but seeking maximum impact. Move between intense heat and invigorating cold, alternating between our Finnish sauna (90°C), aromatherapy steam room (55°C), and cold plunges (5-7°C) to awaken your senses, boost circulation, and enhance recovery. Whether you're prepping for the day ahead or winding down pre or post-movement, this express bathing ritual will leave you feeling refreshed, recharged, and rebalanced.

Slow Flow Yoga

A deeply calming and gentle practice designed to regulate the nervous system and bring a sense of relaxation to the mind and body. This 60-minute class incorporates mindful movement, breath awareness, and stillness to release tension, promote deep rest, and restore balance. Yin Yoga & Sound

Experience deep relaxation and inner balance with our Yin Yoga & Sound class. This gentle, meditative practice combines long-held, restorative yoga poses with the therapeutic vibrations of sound to calm the nervous system and release tension. Perfect for all levels, this class is ideal for anyone looking to unwind, reset, and reconnect with themselves.

Yin Yoga & Sound

Experience deep relaxation and inner balance with our Yin Yoga & Sound class. This gentle, meditative practice combines long-held, restorative yoga poses with the therapeutic vibrations of sound to calm the nervous system and release tension. Perfect for all levels, this class is ideal for anyone looking to unwind, reset, and reconnect with themselves.

Move between intense heat and invigorating cold, alternating between our Finnish sauna (90°C), aromatherapy steam room (55°C), and cold plunges (5-7°C) to awaken your senses, boost circulation, and enhance recovery. Whether you're prepping for the day ahead or winding down pre or post-movement, this express bathing ritual will leave you feeling refreshed, recharged, and rebalanced.

Move between intense heat and invigorating cold, alternating between our Finnish sauna (90°C), aromatherapy steam room (55°C), and cold plunges (5-7°C) to awaken your senses, boost circulation, and enhance recovery. Whether you're prepping for the day ahead or winding down pre or post-movement, this express bathing ritual will leave you feeling refreshed, recharged, and rebalanced.

When life gets overwhelming, and you need to de-stress and unwind, our Signature Journey is here for you. Think of this experience as a massage for the mind. Navigate through our serene spaces designed for optimal relaxation and restoration, including our immersive theatre room, light & sound therapy dome, breathwork and meditation lounge and bathhouse. Please know our bathhouse is a phone-free and quiet space. Guests receive refreshments and a locker for maximum comfort each visit.

Perfect for all levels, this class is ideal for anyone looking to unwind, reset, and reconnect with themselves.

A deeply calming and gentle practice designed to regulate the nervous system and bring a sense of relaxation to the mind and body. This 60-minute class incorporates mindful movement, breath awareness, and stillness to release tension, promote deep rest, and restore balance. No prior yoga experience needed, just come as you are and allow yourself to fully relax.

Yin Yoga & Sound

Experience deep relaxation and inner balance with our Yin Yoga & Sound class. This gentle, meditative practice combines long-held, restorative yoga poses with the therapeutic vibrations of sound to calm the nervous system and release tension. The combination of deep stretching and resonant sound helps to improve flexibility, enhance mindfulness, and bring a profound sense of peace.

Perfect for all levels, this class is ideal for anyone looking to unwind, reset, and reconnect with themselves.

Perfect for all levels, this class is ideal for anyone looking to unwind, reset, and reconnect with themselves.

Unwind and relax with EQ’s 90-minute Bathhouse Session, designed to restore both mind and body. Embark on your own journey through the space or try one of our seasonal protocol circuits.

45 Minute Bathhouse Session

Reset your body and mind in just 45 minutes with EQ’s 45 Minute Bathhouse Session—a dynamic contrast therapy designed for those short on time but seeking maximum impact. Move between intense heat and invigorating cold, alternating between our Finnish sauna (90°C), aromatherapy steam room (55°C), and cold plunges (5-7°C) to awaken your senses, boost circulation, and enhance recovery. Whether you're prepping for the day ahead or winding down pre or post-movement, this express bathing ritual will leave you feeling refreshed, recharged, and rebalanced.

Please know our bathhouse is a phone-free and quiet space. Guests receive refreshments and a locker for maximum comfort each visit.

Unwind and relax with EQ’s 90-minute Bathhouse Session, designed to restore both mind and body. Embark on your own journey through the space or try one of our seasonal protocol circuits.

Perfect for all levels, this class is ideal for anyone looking to unwind, reset, and reconnect with themselves.

Your nervous system wasn't designed to push this hard, this often. This is your circuit breaker.

Experience deep relaxation and inner balance with our Yin Yoga & Sound class. Perfect for all levels, this class is ideal for anyone looking to unwind, reset, and reconnect with themselves.

Slow Flow Yoga

A deeply calming and gentle practice designed to regulate the nervous system and bring a sense of relaxation to the mind and body. This 60-minute class incorporates mindful movement, breath awareness, and stillness to release tension, promote deep rest, and restore balance. You’ll be guided through this flow that will encourage the mind and body to soften. Perfect for anyone looking to unwind, reduce stress, and cultivate inner peace. No prior yoga experience needed, just come as you are and allow yourself to fully relax.

Yin Yoga & Sound

Experience deep relaxation and inner balance with our Yin Yoga & Sound class. This gentle, meditative practice combines long-held, restorative yoga poses with the therapeutic vibrations of sound to calm the nervous system and release tension. The combination of deep stretching and resonant sound helps to improve flexibility, enhance mindfulness, and bring a profound sense of peace.

Perfect for all levels, this class is ideal for anyone looking to unwind, reset, and reconnect with themselves.

Express Bathing Experience

Reset your body and mind in just 45 minutes with EQ’s 45-minute Bathhouse Session—a dynamic contrast therapy designed for those short on time but seeking maximum impact. Move between intense heat and invigorating cold, alternating between our Finnish sauna (90°C), aromatherapy steam room (55°C), and cold plunges (5-7°C) to awaken your senses, boost circulation, and enhance recovery. Whether you're prepping for the day ahead or winding down pre or post-movement, this express bathing ritual will leave you feeling refreshed, recharged, and rebalanced.

Slow Flow Yoga

A deeply calming and gentle practice designed to regulate the nervous system and bring a sense of relaxation to the mind and body. This 60-minute class incorporates mindful movement, breath awareness, and stillness to release tension, promote deep rest, and restore balance. You’ll be guided through this flow that will encourage the mind and body to soften. Perfect for anyone looking to unwind, reduce stress, and cultivate inner peace. No prior yoga experience needed, just come as you are and allow yourself to fully relax.

Yin Yoga & Sound

Experience deep relaxation and inner balance with our Yin Yoga & Sound class. This gentle, meditative practice combines long-held, restorative yoga poses with the therapeutic vibrations of sound to calm the nervous system and release tension. The combination of deep stretching and resonant sound helps to improve flexibility, enhance mindfulness, and bring a profound sense of peace.

Perfect for all levels, this class is ideal for anyone looking to unwind, reset, and reconnect with themselves.

Express Bathing Experience

Reset your body and mind in just 45 minutes with EQ’s 45-minute Bathhouse Session—a dynamic contrast therapy designed for those short on time but seeking maximum impact. Move between intense heat and invigorating cold, alternating between our Finnish sauna (90°C), aromatherapy steam room (55°C), and cold plunges (5-7°C) to awaken your senses, boost circulation, and enhance recovery. Whether you're prepping for the day ahead or winding down pre or post-movement, this express bathing ritual will leave you feeling refreshed, recharged, and rebalanced.

Slow Flow Yoga

A deeply calming and gentle practice designed to regulate the nervous system and bring a sense of relaxation to the mind and body. This 60-minute class incorporates mindful movement, breath awareness, and stillness to release tension, promote deep rest, and restore balance. You’ll be guided through this flow that will encourage the mind and body to soften. Perfect for anyone looking to unwind, reduce stress, and cultivate inner peace. No prior yoga experience needed, just come as you are and allow yourself to fully relax.

Yin Yoga & Sound

Experience deep relaxation and inner balance with our Yin Yoga & Sound class. This gentle, meditative practice combines long-held, restorative yoga poses with the therapeutic vibrations of sound to calm the nervous system and release tension. The combination of deep stretching and resonant sound helps to improve flexibility, enhance mindfulness, and bring a profound sense of peace.

Perfect for all levels, this class is ideal for anyone looking to unwind, reset, and reconnect with themselves.

Slow Flow Yoga

A deeply calming and gentle practice designed to regulate the nervous system and bring a sense of relaxation to the mind and body. This 60-minute class incorporates mindful movement, breath awareness, and stillness to release tension, promote deep rest, and restore balance. You’ll be guided through this flow that will encourage the mind and body to soften. Perfect for anyone looking to unwind, reduce stress, and cultivate inner peace. No prior yoga experience needed, just come as you are and allow yourself to fully relax.

Yin Yoga & Sound

Experience deep relaxation and inner balance with our Yin Yoga & Sound class. This gentle, meditative practice combines long-held, restorative yoga poses with the therapeutic vibrations of sound to calm the nervous system and release tension. The combination of deep stretching and resonant sound helps to improve flexibility, enhance mindfulness, and bring a profound sense of peace.

Perfect for all levels, this class is ideal for anyone looking to unwind, reset, and reconnect with themselves.

No prior yoga experience needed, just come as you are and allow yourself to fully relax.

Slow Flow Yoga

A deeply calming and gentle practice designed to regulate the nervous system and bring a sense of relaxation to the mind and body. This 60-minute class incorporates mindful movement, breath awareness, and stillness to release tension, promote deep rest, and restore balance. You’ll be guided through this flow that will encourage the mind and body to soften. Perfect for anyone looking to unwind, reduce stress, and cultivate inner peace. No prior yoga experience needed, just come as you are and allow yourself to fully relax.

Yin Yoga & Sound

Experience deep relaxation and inner balance with our Yin Yoga & Sound class. This gentle, meditative practice combines long-held, restorative yoga poses with the therapeutic vibrations of sound to calm the nervous system and release tension. The combination of deep stretching and resonant sound helps to improve flexibility, enhance mindfulness, and bring a profound sense of peace.

Perfect for all levels, this class is ideal for anyone looking to unwind, reset, and reconnect with themselves.

Yin Yoga & Sound

Experience deep relaxation and inner balance with our Yin Yoga & Sound class. Perfect for all levels, this class is ideal for anyone looking to unwind, reset, and reconnect with themselves.

Please know our bathhouse is a phone-free and quiet space. Guests receive refreshments and a locker for maximum comfort each visit.

Unwind and relax with EQ’s 90-minute Bathhouse Session, designed to restore both mind and body. Over 90 minutes, immerse yourself in century old bathing traditions utilising our purposefully designed hot mineral spa (35-37 degrees), traditional Finnish sauna (90 degrees), aromatherapy steam room (55 degrees), and invigorating cold plunges (5-7 degrees). Embark on your own journey through the space or try one of our seasonal protocol circuits.

Slow Flow Yoga

A deeply calming and gentle practice designed to regulate the nervous system and bring a sense of relaxation to the mind and body. This 60-minute class incorporates mindful movement, breath awareness, and stillness to release tension, promote deep rest, and restore balance. You’ll be guided through this flow that will encourage the mind and body to soften. Perfect for anyone looking to unwind, reduce stress, and cultivate inner peace. No prior yoga experience needed, just come as you are and allow yourself to fully relax.

Slow Flow Yoga

A deeply calming and gentle practice designed to regulate the nervous system and bring a sense of relaxation to the mind and body. This 60-minute class incorporates mindful movement, breath awareness, and stillness to release tension, promote deep rest, and restore balance. You’ll be guided through this flow that will encourage the mind and body to soften. Perfect for anyone looking to unwind, reduce stress, and cultivate inner peace. No prior yoga experience needed, just come as you are and allow yourself to fully relax.

Express Bathing Experience

Reset your body and mind in just 45 minutes with EQ’s 45-minute Bathhouse Session—a dynamic contrast therapy designed for those short on time but seeking maximum impact. Move between intense heat and invigorating cold, alternating between our Finnish sauna (90°C), aromatherapy steam room (55°C), and cold plunges (5-7°C) to awaken your senses, boost circulation, and enhance recovery. Whether you're prepping for the day ahead or winding down pre or post-movement, this express bathing ritual will leave you feeling refreshed, recharged, and rebalanced.

Express Bathing Experience

Reset your body and mind in just 45 minutes with EQ’s 45-minute Bathhouse Session—a dynamic contrast therapy designed for those short on time but seeking maximum impact. Whether you're prepping for the day ahead or winding down pre or post-movement, this express bathing ritual will leave you feeling refreshed, recharged, and rebalanced.

Please know our bathhouse is a phone-free and quiet space. Guests receive refreshments and a locker for maximum comfort each visit.

Unwind and relax with EQ’s 90-minute Bathhouse Session, designed to restore both mind and body. Over 90 minutes, immerse yourself in century old bathing traditions utilising our purposefully designed hot mineral spa (35-37 degrees), traditional Finnish sauna (90 degrees), aromatherapy steam room (55 degrees), and invigorating cold plunges (5-7 degrees). Embark on your own journey through the space or try one of our seasonal protocol circuits.

Unwind and relax with EQ’s 90-minute Bathhouse Session, designed to restore both mind and body. Embark on your own journey through the space or try one of our seasonal protocol circuits.

Whether you're prepping for the day ahead or winding down pre or post-movement, this express bathing ritual will leave you feeling refreshed, recharged, and rebalanced.

Embark on your own journey through the space or try one of our seasonal protocol circuits.

Start your week from a place of clarity and calm.

When your mind feels scattered or your body is carrying the week’s tension, it is often a sign that your breath has become shallow and your system is working harder than it needs to.

This immersive sound and breathwork session is designed to ground you gently. Through slow, intentional breathing and soothing sound frequencies, you’ll shift from overstimulation to ease, creating space for rest, focus and a more centred start to the days ahead.

What to expect:
– Guided breathwork to soften the body and regulate your energy
– Immersive sound experience using bowls, chimes and warm ambient tones
– Supportive rest setup with bolsters, blankets and aromatherapy
– A brief integration to help you anchor the benefits into the week

Limited to 10 participants.

Express Bathing Experience

Reset your body and mind in just 45 minutes with EQ’s 45-minute Bathhouse Session—a dynamic contrast therapy designed for those short on time but seeking maximum impact. Move between intense heat and invigorating cold, alternating between our Finnish sauna (90°C), aromatherapy steam room (55°C), and cold plunges (5-7°C) to awaken your senses, boost circulation, and enhance recovery. Whether you're prepping for the day ahead or winding down pre or post-movement, this express bathing ritual will leave you feeling refreshed, recharged, and rebalanced.

Unwind and relax with EQ’s 90-minute Bathhouse Session, designed to restore both mind and body. Embark on your own journey through the space or try one of our seasonal protocol circuits.

Please know our bathhouse is a phone-free and quiet space. Guests receive refreshments and a locker for maximum comfort each visit.

Unwind and relax with EQ’s 90-minute Bathhouse Session, designed to restore both mind and body. Over 90 minutes, immerse yourself in century old bathing traditions utilising our purposefully designed hot mineral spa (35-37 degrees), traditional Finnish sauna (90 degrees), aromatherapy steam room (55 degrees), and invigorating cold plunges (5-7 degrees). Embark on your own journey through the space or try one of our seasonal protocol circuits.

Please know our bathhouse is a phone-free and quiet space. Guests receive refreshments and a locker for maximum comfort each visit.

Unwind and relax with EQ’s 90-minute Bathhouse Session, designed to restore both mind and body. Over 90 minutes, immerse yourself in century old bathing traditions utilising our purposefully designed hot mineral spa (35-37 degrees), traditional Finnish sauna (90 degrees), aromatherapy steam room (55 degrees), and invigorating cold plunges (5-7 degrees). Embark on your own journey through the space or try one of our seasonal protocol circuits.

Please know our bathhouse is a phone-free and quiet space. Guests receive refreshments and a locker for maximum comfort each visit.

New to contrast therapy? This guided 60-minute session introduces you to the benefits of hot and cold in a supportive, beginner-friendly way. You’ll be guided through each bathhouse modality, learning how to safely transition between heat and cold while understanding the purpose behind each step. Perfect for anyone curious about contrast therapy or wanting to build confidence in their practice.

Unwind and relax with EQ’s 90-minute Bathhouse Session, designed to restore both mind and body. Over 90 minutes, immerse yourself in century old bathing traditions utilising our purposefully designed hot mineral spa (35-37 degrees), traditional Finnish sauna (90 degrees), aromatherapy steam room (55 degrees), and invigorating cold plunges (5-7 degrees). Embark on your own journey through the space or try one of our seasonal protocol circuits.

Please know our bathhouse is a phone-free and quiet space. Guests receive refreshments and a locker for maximum comfort each visit.

Unwind and relax with EQ’s 90-minute Bathhouse Session, designed to restore both mind and body. Over 90 minutes, immerse yourself in century old bathing traditions utilising our purposefully designed hot mineral spa (35-37 degrees), traditional Finnish sauna (90 degrees), aromatherapy steam room (55 degrees), and invigorating cold plunges (5-7 degrees). Embark on your own journey through the space or try one of our seasonal protocol circuits.

Please know our bathhouse is a phone-free and quiet space. Guests receive refreshments and a locker for maximum comfort each visit.

Unwind and relax with EQ’s 90-minute Bathhouse Session, designed to restore both mind and body. Over 90 minutes, immerse yourself in century old bathing traditions utilising our purposefully designed hot mineral spa (35-37 degrees), traditional Finnish sauna (90 degrees), aromatherapy steam room (55 degrees), and invigorating cold plunges (5-7 degrees). Embark on your own journey through the space or try one of our seasonal protocol circuits.
Your 60-minute Bathhouse visit to reset between work, training or the weekend ahead. Enjoy access to our warm mineral pool, cold plunges, traditional sauna and aromatherapy steam room.

Please know our bathhouse is a phone-free and quiet space. Guests receive refreshments and a locker for maximum comfort each visit.

Unwind and relax with EQ’s 90-minute Bathhouse Session, designed to restore both mind and body. Over 90 minutes, immerse yourself in century old bathing traditions utilising our purposefully designed hot mineral spa (35-37 degrees), traditional Finnish sauna (90 degrees), aromatherapy steam room (55 degrees), and invigorating cold plunges (5-7 degrees). Embark on your own journey through the space or try one of our seasonal protocol circuits.

Please know our bathhouse is a phone-free and quiet space. Guests receive refreshments and a locker for maximum comfort each visit.

Unwind and relax with EQ’s 90-minute Bathhouse Session, designed to restore both mind and body. Over 90 minutes, immerse yourself in century old bathing traditions utilising our purposefully designed hot mineral spa (35-37 degrees), traditional Finnish sauna (90 degrees), aromatherapy steam room (55 degrees), and invigorating cold plunges (5-7 degrees). Embark on your own journey through the space or try one of our seasonal protocol circuits.

sessions.sessionName: Live Sound Bath in the Bathhouse
sessions.level:
Begin the new week from a place of deep calm.

The Sunday scaries aren't about lack of preparation, they're about a nervous system stuck in overdrive.

This live sound bath, part of our Dream State season, is designed to bring you back into balance.

As facilitator Kim plays live throughout the bathhouse, you'll move at your own pace between the hot and cold modalities, letting resonant sound carry you from stress to stillness and into rest, sleep, and a more grounded start to the week.What to expect:

– Live sound immersion throughout the bathhouse: crystal bowls, chimes, ambient textures
– Freedom to move between the hot and cold modalities at your own pace
– Sound designed to downshift the nervous system into deep rest
– A slow, intentional close to your Sunday so you arrive into Monday settled rather than racing

Limited to 10 participants.

Yin, Sound & Bathe

A 90-minute evening that brings the studio and the bathhouse together in a single booking.

Begin with 45 minutes of yin yoga and sound healing in the studio. Long-held, restorative postures paired with the therapeutic vibrations of singing bowls and chimes to calm the nervous system and release tension.

From there, move into the bathhouse for 45 minutes where you'll move between our hot magnesium pool, sauna, steam, and cold plunge

It's a slower way to spend a winter evening at EQ. Suitable for all levels.

sessions.sessionName: Live Sound Bath in the Bathhouse
sessions.level:
Begin the new week from a place of deep calm.

The Sunday scaries aren't about lack of preparation, they're about a nervous system stuck in overdrive.

This live sound bath, part of our Dream State season, is designed to bring you back into balance.

As facilitator Kim plays live throughout the bathhouse, you'll move at your own pace between the hot and cold modalities, letting resonant sound carry you from stress to stillness and into rest, sleep, and a more grounded start to the week.What to expect:

– Live sound immersion throughout the bathhouse: crystal bowls, chimes, ambient textures
– Freedom to move between the hot and cold modalities at your own pace
– Sound designed to downshift the nervous system into deep rest
– A slow, intentional close to your Sunday so you arrive into Monday settled rather than racing

Limited to 10 participants.

When you're carrying something and need to move through it, not just sit with it.

30 minutes of audio-led breathwork in our immersive room. Choose Unwind if you need to decompress slowly - good if you're new to breathwork or the weight of the week has settled in. Choose Energise if stillness won't cut it and your system needs to move before it can rest.

60 minutes in the Bathhouse follows: sauna, aroma steam, mineral spa, cold plunge. Not to relax after but to integrate what the breathwork began.

You'll leave lighter than you arrived.

Weekday sessions only. Bathers required.

When your mind won't stop and you don't have the whole day.

Begin with 30 minutes in the Dome - immersive light, sound and low-frequency vibration that quiets mental noise without asking anything of you. No experience necessary. The environment does the work.

60 minutes in the Bathhouse follows: sauna, aroma steam, mineral spa, cold plunge.

You'll leave calm in a way you didn't manufacture.

Weekday sessions only. Bathers required.

sessions.sessionName: Live Sound Bath in the Bathhouse
sessions.level:
Begin the new week from a place of deep calm.

The Sunday scaries aren't about lack of preparation, they're about a nervous system stuck in overdrive.

This live sound bath, part of our Dream State season, is designed to bring you back into balance.

As facilitator Kim plays live throughout the bathhouse, you'll move at your own pace between the hot and cold modalities, letting resonant sound carry you from stress to stillness and into rest, sleep, and a more grounded start to the week.What to expect:

– Live sound immersion throughout the bathhouse: crystal bowls, chimes, ambient textures
– Freedom to move between the hot and cold modalities at your own pace
– Sound designed to downshift the nervous system into deep rest
– A slow, intentional close to your Sunday so you arrive into Monday settled rather than racing

Limited to 10 participants.

When you're carrying something and need to move through it, not just sit with it.

30 minutes of audio-led breathwork in our immersive room. Choose Unwind if you need to decompress slowly - good if you're new to breathwork or the weight of the week has settled in. Choose Energise if stillness won't cut it and your system needs to move before it can rest.

60 minutes in the Bathhouse follows: sauna, aroma steam, mineral spa, cold plunge. Not to relax after but to integrate what the breathwork began.

You'll leave lighter than you arrived.

Weekday sessions only. Bathers required.

60 minutes in the Bathhouse follows: sauna, aroma steam, mineral spa, cold plunge.

You'll leave calm in a way you didn't manufacture.

When you're carrying something and need to move through it, not just sit with it.

30 minutes of audio-led breathwork in our immersive room. Choose Unwind if you need to decompress slowly - good if you're new to breathwork or the weight of the week has settled in. Choose Energise if stillness won't cut it and your system needs to move before it can rest.

60 minutes in the Bathhouse follows: sauna, aroma steam, mineral spa, cold plunge. Not to relax after but to integrate what the breathwork began.

You'll leave lighter than you arrived.

Weekday sessions only. Bathers required.

When your mind won't stop and you don't have the whole day.

Begin with 30 minutes in the Dome - immersive light, sound and low-frequency vibration that quiets mental noise without asking anything of you. No experience necessary. The environment does the work.

60 minutes in the Bathhouse follows: sauna, aroma steam, mineral spa, cold plunge.

You'll leave calm in a way you didn't manufacture.

Weekday sessions only. Bathers required.

When you're carrying something and need to move through it, not just sit with it.

30 minutes of audio-led breathwork in our immersive room. Choose Unwind if you need to decompress slowly - good if you're new to breathwork or the weight of the week has settled in. Choose Energise if stillness won't cut it and your system needs to move before it can rest.

60 minutes in the Bathhouse follows: sauna, aroma steam, mineral spa, cold plunge. Not to relax after but to integrate what the breathwork began.

You'll leave lighter than you arrived.

Weekday sessions only. Bathers required.

When your mind won't stop and you don't have the whole day.

Begin with 30 minutes in the Dome - immersive light, sound and low-frequency vibration that quiets mental noise without asking anything of you. No experience necessary. The environment does the work.

60 minutes in the Bathhouse follows: sauna, aroma steam, mineral spa, cold plunge.

You'll leave calm in a way you didn't manufacture.

Weekday sessions only. Bathers required.

sessions.sessionName: Live Sound Bath in the Bathhouse
sessions.level:
Begin the new week from a place of deep calm.

The Sunday scaries aren't about lack of preparation, they're about a nervous system stuck in overdrive.

This live sound bath, part of our Dream State season, is designed to bring you back into balance.

As facilitator Kim plays live throughout the bathhouse, you'll move at your own pace between the hot and cold modalities, letting resonant sound carry you from stress to stillness and into rest, sleep, and a more grounded start to the week.What to expect:

– Live sound immersion throughout the bathhouse: crystal bowls, chimes, ambient textures
– Freedom to move between the hot and cold modalities at your own pace
– Sound designed to downshift the nervous system into deep rest
– A slow, intentional close to your Sunday so you arrive into Monday settled rather than racing

Limited to 10 participants.

sessions.sessionName: The Lymphatic Ritual: An Evening with Skintrition
sessions.level:
An intimate winter evening for 10 guests.

Think clearer skin, less puffiness, a body and mind that feels lighter. It’s the specific kind of glow that comes when everything is moving the way it should.

Most of us have never been known how to support our lymphatic system – and when it’s working well, you feel it. Better sleep, reduced bloating and skin that looks alive.

Steph Cannalonga of Skintrition, a Melbourne skin clinic established in 1983, guides you through a gentle, rhythmic lymphatic drainage technique designed to stimulate the lymph nodes, pump the system and encourage flow throughout the body. Her approach sits at the same intersection EQ works in: when the nervous system is regulated and the lymphatic system is moving, the body can do what it’s designed to do.

In 90 minutes you will learn a practice that reduces bloating and water retention, improves sleep quality, supports your immune system, and leaves your skin visibly clearer. You’ll take the technique into the EQ Bathhouse – steam room, mineral spa and cold plunge – letting the heat and steam work with your skin to deepen the results. 

You leave with a take-home gift card to continue working on your skin ritual at home.

A Tuesday night at EQ worth making plans for.

$189 per person. Includes take-home gift.

Start your week from a place of clarity and calm.

When your mind feels scattered or your body is carrying the week's tension, it is often a sign that your breath has become shallow and your system is working harder than it needs to.

This immersive sound and breathwork session is designed to ground you gently. Through slow, guided breathing and soothing sound frequencies, you'll shift from overstimulation to ease, creating space for rest, focus and a more centred start to the days ahead.

What to expect:
– Guided breathwork to soften the body and settle the nervous system
– Immersive sound experience using bowls, chimes and warm ambient tones
– Supportive rest setup with bolsters, blankets and aromatherapy
– A brief integration to help you carry the benefits into the week

Limited to 10 participants.

sessions.sessionName: The Lymphatic Ritual: An Evening with Skintrition
sessions.level:
An intimate winter evening for 10 guests.

Think clearer skin, less puffiness, a body and mind that feels lighter. It’s the specific kind of glow that comes when everything is moving the way it should.

Most of us have never been known how to support our lymphatic system – and when it’s working well, you feel it. Better sleep, reduced bloating and skin that looks alive.

Steph Cannalonga of Skintrition, a Melbourne skin clinic established in 1983, guides you through a gentle, rhythmic lymphatic drainage technique designed to stimulate the lymph nodes, pump the system and encourage flow throughout the body. Her approach sits at the same intersection EQ works in: when the nervous system is regulated and the lymphatic system is moving, the body can do what it’s designed to do.

In 90 minutes you will learn a practice that reduces bloating and water retention, improves sleep quality, supports your immune system, and leaves your skin visibly clearer. You’ll take the technique into the EQ Bathhouse – steam room, mineral spa and cold plunge – letting the heat and steam work with your skin to deepen the results. 

You leave with a take-home gift card to continue working on your skin ritual at home.

A Tuesday night at EQ worth making plans for.

$189 per person. Includes take-home gift.

Start your week from a place of clarity and calm.

When your mind feels scattered or your body is carrying the week's tension, it is often a sign that your breath has become shallow and your system is working harder than it needs to.

This immersive sound and breathwork session is designed to ground you gently. Through slow, guided breathing and soothing sound frequencies, you'll shift from overstimulation to ease, creating space for rest, focus and a more centred start to the days ahead.

What to expect:
– Guided breathwork to soften the body and settle the nervous system
– Immersive sound experience using bowls, chimes and warm ambient tones
– Supportive rest setup with bolsters, blankets and aromatherapy
– A brief integration to help you carry the benefits into the week

Limited to 10 participants.

When your mind won't stop and you don't have the whole day.

60 minutes in the Bathhouse follows: sauna, aroma steam, mineral spa, cold plunge.

You'll leave calm in a way you didn't manufacture.

Weekday sessions only. Bathers required.

When you're carrying something and need to move through it, not just sit with it.

30 minutes of audio-led breathwork in our immersive room. Choose Unwind if you need to decompress slowly - good if you're new to breathwork or the weight of the week has settled in. Choose Energise if stillness won't cut it and your system needs to move before it can rest.

60 minutes in the Bathhouse follows: sauna, aroma steam, mineral spa, cold plunge. Not to relax after but to integrate what the breathwork began.

You'll leave lighter than you arrived.

Weekday sessions only. Bathers required.
